description: Source code for managing cache rankings in Chromium's disk cache implementation, including classes and functions for list manipulation, crash simulation, and transaction handling.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Handles crash-safe transactions for cache list modifications.

classes.name: Rankings
classes.description: Manages cache ranking lists, including insertion, removal, validation, and recovery operations.

methods.name: GenerateCrash
methods.description: Simulates crashes at specific points for testing crash recovery.

methods.name: UpdateTimes
methods.description: Updates last used and last modified timestamps of ranking nodes.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Rankings object with backend data.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node into the ranking list.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the ranking list.

methods.name: UpdateRank
methods.description: Updates the position of a node in the ranking list.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next node in the list.

methods.name: GetPrev
methods.description: Retrieves the previous node in the list.

methods.name: CheckLinks
methods.description: Validates the integrity of links between nodes.
